errors.evidence: The machine description claims the 2020 value for 'жилищни' (housing) was 3944, but this value corresponds to 'други' (other) buildings.
The machine description fails to state that the chart represents the number of building permits issued for new buildings by NSI data.
The machine description states the x-axis range but does not mention the y-axis lacks unit descriptions.
The value 187 in 2014 actually corresponds to 'административни' (administrative) buildings, but it is not described appropriately, leading to confusion.
